face.name: 冰喉
face.text: 嘲讽，亡语： 如果你的手牌中有龙牌，则对所有随从造成3点伤害。
face.flavorText: 冰喉一心想要毁掉锦标赛。至于原因，都是因为那些吵闹个不停的熊孩子们！

face.name: Chillmaw
face.text: Taunt Deathrattle: If you're holding a Dragon, deal 3 damage to all minions.
face.flavorText: Chillmaw keeps trying to ruin the Grand Tournament, and she would've done it too, if it weren't for those dang kids!

face.name: 女警萨莉
face.text: 亡语：对所有敌方随从造成等同于本随从攻击力的伤害。
face.flavorText: “这家伙是谁？她从哪儿来？加基森根本就没有警察局啊！”，诺格弗格市长如是说。

face.name: Sergeant Sally
face.text: Deathrattle: Deal damage equal to this minion's Attack to all enemy minions.
face.flavorText: "Who is she? Where did she come from? We don't even have a police force here in Gadgetzan!!" - Mayor Noggenfogger

face.name: 穆克拉
face.text: 战吼：使你的对手获得两根香蕉。
face.flavorText: 穆克拉在哈圭罗岛上徘徊，寻找他的真爱。

face.name: King Mukla
face.text: Battlecry: Give your opponent 2 Bananas.
face.flavorText: King Mukla wanders Jaguero Isle, searching for love.

face.name: 火车王里诺艾
face.text: 冲锋，战吼： 为你的对手召唤两条1/1的雏龙。
face.flavorText: 至少他还有愤怒的小鸡。

face.name: Leeroy Jenkins
face.text: Charge. Battlecry: Summon two 1/1 Whelps for your opponent.
face.flavorText: At least he has Angry Chicken.

face.name: 奥妮克希亚
face.text: 战吼：召唤数条1/1的雏龙，直到你的随从数量达到上限。
face.flavorText: 伪装成女伯爵卡特拉娜·普瑞斯托，奥妮克希亚长期控制着暴风城议会。你可能会想，一定是她的大翅膀和鳞片让她漏出了马脚。

face.name: Onyxia
face.text: Battlecry: Summon 1/1 Whelps until your side of the battlefield is full.
face.flavorText: Onyxia long manipulated the Stormwind Court by disguising herself as Lady Katrana Prestor. You would have thought that the giant wings and scales would have been a giveaway.

face.name: 爆破大师弗拉克
face.text: 战吼：召唤四个0/2的地精炸弹。
face.flavorText: 一份好计划通常需要一些耐心……和成吨的炸弹。

face.name: Boommaster Flark
face.text: Battlecry: Summon four 0/2 Goblin Bombs.
face.flavorText: Every good plan requires a bit of patience. And a lot of explosives.

face.name: 砰砰博士
face.text: 战吼： 召唤两个1/1的砰砰机器人。警告：该机器人随时可能爆炸。
face.flavorText: 让你见识一下他的厉害！

face.name: Dr. Boom
face.text: Battlecry: Summon two 1/1 Boom Bots. WARNING: Bots may explode.
face.flavorText: MARVEL AT HIS MIGHT!

face.name: 大厨诺米
face.text: 战吼：如果你的牌库里没有牌，则召唤六个6/6的猛火元素。
face.flavorText: 他的烹饪技艺真是……熟透了。

face.name: Chef Nomi
face.text: Battlecry: If your deck is empty, summon six 6/6 Greasefire Elementals.
face.flavorText: His cooking is always very well done.

face.name: 诺萨莉
face.text: 战吼：为双方英雄恢复所有生命值。
face.flavorText: 在另一条时间线上，她能把两个英雄都弄死。

face.name: Nozari
face.text: Battlecry: Restore both heroes to full Health.
face.flavorText: In another timeline, she was called Yeszari.

face.name: 凯吉·海德
face.text: 亡语：召唤一只9/9并具有冲锋和嘲讽的凋零野猪。
face.flavorText: 脑袋卡进笼子一阵子，新绰号跟你一辈子。

face.name: Cage Head
face.text: Deathrattle: Summon a 9/9 Blight Boar with Charge and Taunt.
face.flavorText: You get your head stuck in a cage ONCE, and all of a sudden you've got a new nickname.

face.name: 斯塔拉格
face.text: 亡语：如果费尔根也在本局对战中死亡，召唤塔迪乌斯。
face.flavorText: 斯塔拉格想要亲自填写自己的卡牌趣文。“斯塔拉格棒极了！”

face.name: Stalagg
face.text: Deathrattle: If Feugen also died this game, summon Thaddius.
face.flavorText: Stalagg want to write own flavor text. "STALAGG AWESOME!"

face.name: 费尔根
face.text: 亡语：如果斯塔拉格也在本局对战中死亡，召唤塔迪乌斯。
face.flavorText: 费尔根很悲伤，因为所有人都喜欢斯塔拉格。

face.name: Feugen
face.text: Deathrattle: If Stalagg also died this game, summon Thaddius.
face.flavorText: Feugen is sad because everyone likes Stalagg better.

face.name: 先知者沃
face.text: 扰魔。在你施放一个法术后，&发现一张来自过去的自然法术牌。
face.flavorText: 她冥想了两个星期，心无旁骛地探知着宇宙的每一个角落，事无巨细，无所不包。当她从冥想中醒来，口中只吐出了一个声音：“喔。”

face.name: Farseer Wo
face.text: Elusive After you cast a spell,& Discover a Nature spell from the past.
face.flavorText: For two weeks, she meditated in silence, undisturbed as she peered into the endless, unfolding facets of the universe. No pathway lay unexplored, no stone left unturned. When she finally snapped from her fugue, she uttered a single word: "Woah."

face.name: 恋旧风潮
face.text: 将所有随从变形成为来自过去的随机传说随从。
face.flavorText: 风潮不改旧传说，相看恍如昨。

face.name: Wave of Nostalgia
face.text: Transform ALL minions into random Legendary ones from the past.
face.flavorText: Ja, please don't freeze my minions. No stall, ja????

new_dependency_fact_source: Complete fixed client rows;seven printed producer collection links checked;Thaddius is the normal named constructed token,not an adventure boss. No missing body is inferred blank.
policies: Seven actual collection-related links retain distinct source token identities,including Leeroy EX1_116t versus Onyxia ds1_whelptoken.
Fixed summons use existing attributed SummonByCard requests;Onyxia uses the existing original-capacity FillBoardWithCard plan. No card-local summon interpreter or source-less fake request.
Mukla gives two existing Bananas to the opponent and reveals the known fixed gift face to the giver through ordinary information rules.

Chillmaw checks the executing owner current hand Dragon/all facts;Sally uses original callback death.attack or source.attack,matching the shared interpreter first/repeated callback policy;neither uses printed Attack or Spell Damage.
Feugen/Stalagg query both players actual death history for the other original face and summon normal FP1_014t;printed/current physical zones do not replace death facts.
Nozari requests both current maximum Health values in one ordinary HealBatch;overheal,conversion,source multipliers and terminal checks remain kernel-owned.

Boom Bot uses an existing uniform four-option ChooseRandomEffects followed by RandomDamage over the original living enemy domain. Local amount-before-target sampling is explicit and not claimed official.

Cage Head and counterpart Deathrattle summons use the existing deathrattle_position helper: natural original death slot,or live carrier right side. Battlecry/fill placement retains the existing shared default policy pending CN calibration.
uncertainties: Exact Boom Bot RNG sampling order and retained granted Poisonous across death inherit local/shared policies;firsthand forum report is not official CN calibration.
Named fill and multiple fixed-summon callbacks retain original kernel acceptance windows,not a new source-specific server timing claim.
Past-set membership,reprint weights,CN exclusions,versions/hotfix and deferred edge calibration remain unchanged unresolved reference questions.
